text.tspan: One point per task; the heavy rule is the mean, which is the forward-transfer number reported everywhere else.
The per-task spread is much wider than the gap between the means, and the distributions overlap almost completely.
Ours and fine-tuning share a median of +0.12 despite different means, and every method makes 12 to 17 of the 50 tasks worse.
So the forward-transfer column orders the methods, but it does not separate them the way the retention columns do.
One seed (seed0) for every method, so the point counts match.
